title: EXIT PERFORM / EXIT PERFORM CYCLE — early break and continue inside a PERFORM (post-2002 standard)
sourceContent:
IDENTIFICATION DIVISION.
       PROGRAM-ID. EARLY-EXIT.
       DATA DIVISION.
       WORKING-STORAGE SECTION.
       01  I       PIC 9(3).
       01  WS-A    PIC 9(5) OCCURS 100 TIMES.
      *> EXIT PERFORM is the 'break' from an inline PERFORM (COBOL
      *> 2002+); EXIT PERFORM CYCLE is 'continue'. Pre-2002 code
      *> simulated these with PERFORM ... UNTIL flags or GO TO. The
      *> spec must capture the early-exit condition explicitly.
       PROCEDURE DIVISION.
       MAIN.
           PERFORM VARYING I FROM 1 BY 1 UNTIL I > 100
              IF WS-A(I) = 0
                 EXIT PERFORM
              END-IF
           END-PERFORM.
           STOP RUN.
notes: EXIT PERFORM is the 2002+ way to write structured early-exit. Pre-2002 legacy uses PERFORM with a flag. A Java break/continue is the natural rewrite. Surface the early-exit condition.
